rows.en: Ciel: "We won... York is finally liberated.
But... Why did Father order Reduce and me
to stand by during such an important battle...?"
Ciel: "...Reduce? Good timing.
Did you hear anything from Father..."
Ciel: "?! Y-You..."
Tyron: "..."
Ciel: "Tyron..."
Tyron: "...Hmph!"
Ciel: "T-Tyron! Why?!"
Tyron: "..."
Ciel: "!! You're... being controlled..."
Tyron: "Uooooooh!!"
Ciel: "Grr... You're as strong as ever... At this rate..."
Tyron: "...Grr..."
Ciel: "Tyron...?"
Tyron: "...Ugh... Grr..."
Ciel: (Is Tyron's will beginning to return...?)
Ciel: "Tyron! It's me! Don't you recognize me?!"
Tyron: "...Ugh... Uoooooooh!"
Ciel: "Aah! F-Father!!"
Reduce: "...Sorry I'm late."
Ciel: "Reduce!"
Tyron: "..."
Reduce: "Tyron... You..."
Tyron: "Urgh..."
Reduce: "...I see..."
Ciel: "R-Reduce, you aren't going to...?!"
Tyron: "Grr... Uoooooh!"
Reduce: "...Tyron, is this... all the strength you have?"
Tyron: "Grrrr..."
Reduce: "Is this all you've got?! Tyron!!"
Tyron: "!!"
Ciel: (He cut Tyron's sword in two...)
Tyron: "..."
Reduce: "...It's decided."
Tyron: "...Heh... Your blade is a hair's breadth from my throat...
Why don't you push its tip forward?"
Reduce: "Was it your own decision to target Ciel?"
Tyron: "...No."
Reduce: "Then I have no reason to cut you down."
Tyron: "Don't you think I might be lying?"
Reduce: "Doubting a friend is more shameful
than being deceived."
Tyron: "Heh."
Reduce: "What's so funny?"
Tyron: "I didn't think those were the words of a man
who had genuinely meant to cut me down."
Reduce: "...You noticed?"
Ciel: "What?! Weren't you being controlled...?"
Tyron: "A voice."
Ciel: "A voice...?"
Tyron: "My friend's voice became a light that led me out of the abyss of darkness."
Ciel: "Then why...?"
Reduce: "Honestly, you're such a clumsy man.
Even if you wanted to lose, there were better ways to do it.
Your acting is as transparent as ever."
Tyron: "...And you attacked me even though you knew.
You're as twisted as ever."
Reduce: "Heh..."
Ciel: "Hey! What are you getting so cozy for?!
Spare a thought for the one who nearly died, would you?!"
Tyron: "Ha, hahaha... My apologies."
Ciel: "Honestly..."
Ciel: "But I'm glad you're yourself again.
Welcome back, Tyron."
Touya: "...That's Melissa?"
Clovis: "Yeah. She's quite a woman, isn't she? Why'd she pick
a stiff like him instead of me?
My seduction skills must be slipping..."
Aurelie: "You did try to make a move on her after all?!"
Clovis: "Oh, no... Hahahahaha..."
Aurelie: "...You lecher."
Yamato: "Oh! Those two are gazing into each other's eyes, meow."
Ai: "Hmm, what a lovely atmosphere."
Kasumi: "It's a reunion between two lovers."
Melissa: "...I'm home."
Xiujian: "Yes. Welcome home."
Kasumi: "Eek!"
Ai: "Wow..."
Clovis: "It's been a year, after all.
Tonight they're probably... Oof!"
Aurelie: "All right, all right. The spectators are leaving!"
Kasumi: "U-Um... Mr. Clovis..."
Aurelie: "Oh, he's fine. He's fine.
You couldn't kill him even if you tried.
Come on, let's go!"
Tyron: "...And that is what happened.
I am sorry for all the trouble I caused."
Arthur: "To deceive the enemy, first deceive your allies.
To gain their trust and infiltrate their ranks,
you deliberately opposed your homeland.
I understand, but surely there was another way."
Aurelie: "Exactly. Ciel thought you'd really
switched sides."
Ciel: "To think I fell for Tyron's acting...
It's utterly embarrassing."
Reduce: "But even Tyron was made to submit...
What sort of drug could do that?"
Garyud: "I do not know. But I feel that the president's purpose
in producing such a thing goes beyond
mere military objectives..."
Clovis: "Tyron, I understand you stayed in Zigrim
to investigate ≪Ze=Ode≫,
but did you learn anything?"
Tyron: "A little. First, the name of the one behind Zigrim
is Lyle Enroad. The man who attacked us earlier.
What he was doing was supplying Zigrim
with technology. That was all."
Maki: "See? My information was right, wasn't it?"
Celica: "But what for?"
Tyron: "It did not seem to be his own idea,
but the objective was to give Zigrim power
and use it to start a war.
And just as they intended, hostilities with Agarthia
began..."
Ai: "Wait a second. Then this invasion of York
wasn't ≪Ze=Ode≫'s objective?"
Tyron: "That's right."
Arthur: "In that case,
we know this invasion of York was President Horem's
proposal, so
it was based on his own
personal intentions."
Xiujian: "So the president himself also used ≪Ze=Ode≫
for his own ends..."
Tyron: "Yes. He turned out to be quite a schemer.
He also plotted Queen Alforina's assassination...
The president did..."
Ai: "What? What do you mean?!
Didn't Alforina escape...?"
Tyron: "No. After you left to return to the Liebhofen,
assassins were sent into the castle.
We arrived just in time, but...
Did Her Majesty tell you about that?"
Ai: "Not a word..."
Tyron: "...I see."
Ai: "President Horem... He was the one..."
Touya: "Ai, calm down."
Ai: "...I know. I won't lose control again.
...This President Horem... Compared with ≪Ze=Ode≫,
isn't he even worse?"
Tyron: "Yes. He is dangerous. I do not know what President Horem
is aiming for, but there is no doubt he desires war.
And of his own free will, at that.
He said the 'drug' he gave me, which creates the perfect soldier,
was a magic drug.
What that means is absolute power.
If so, the possibility that comes to mind is..."
Ymir: "Unifying the world through force..."
Arthur: "But does this 'drug' have
that much power?"
Tyron: "What I was given appears to have been a prototype.
Even so, it had that effect.
The other person's words acted as powerful suggestions with a compulsive force,
and I was seized by the feeling that I had to obey...
It is shameful."
Miyasco: "..."
Sisk: "What's wrong? You look pale."
Miyasco: "I-I'm all right. I'm sorry."
Maki: "...We have a witness right here, so there's probably
no doubt it's true,
but to prove it, we'd need the actual 'stuff'..."
Celica: "And if we make a careless move, they might dispose
of the evidence. If we act, we'll have to hit them all at once,
or they'll get away."
Ai: "I agree. There's no way I'm letting him get away.
We'll gather irrefutable evidence and make him answer
for his crimes!"
Maki: "Then our next destination is the capital."
Ymir: "Yes."
Fain: "It is a shame that this means parting with Lord Garyud."
Garyud: "This is not a parting forever. Besides,
we share your aspirations. Once our problems here are resolved,
we may ride side by side again.
When that day comes, I will train you as promised.
Do not neglect your efforts."
Fain: "Sir! I shall take those words to heart,
train every day without fail, and devote myself to improving
so that I do not disappoint you when we meet again!"
Garyud: "Hahaha! How reassuring."
Touya: "...Come to think of it, you said you'd warned someone to protect Ciel...
You told Reduce beforehand, didn't you?
How'd you figure it out?"
Reduce: "Yes. How exactly
did you learn of this?"
Tyron: "This."
Ciel: "A bell? Oh, it's the same as Father's..."
Garyud: "It is no ordinary bell. Sealed inside it is
a 'chime stone' that can cause its counterpart,
another 'chime stone,' to resonate no matter how far apart they are.
That can also be used to send signals."
Ciel: "Then you knew?!"
Garyud: "No. I never imagined Tyron himself would be sent
as the assassin. I thought they might attack
in Armored Mechs..."
Reduce: "I see."
Ciel: "But why target me?
If they were going after us now that we have lost Her Majesty,
shouldn't they target Father, the pillar of York...?"
Tyron: "..."
Garyud: "Y-Yes..."
Ciel: "So Tyron's words the other day do have something
to do with this, don't they?"
Captain Roa: "...Hmm."
Garyud: "Admiral... But that is..."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Garyud: "...Understood."
Ciel: "..."
Garyud: "........Ciel.
You are not my daughter."
Ciel: "?!"
Reduce: "!?"
Ai: "What?!"
Garyud: "Of course, I mean you are not my daughter by blood.
You... No, Your Highness descends from the current Istarsh royal family,
and is the only person of that bloodline.
And the blood of the former Falmight royal family
also flows in your veins."
Ciel: "N-No... That's a lie..."
Ymir: "Falmight... If I recall correctly, its last king
was Klaas Ars Falmight III.
A tyrant who arose in a dynasty that had ruled benevolently...
Through bloody purges, he even murdered his own relatives.
The people's army, with Aclesia El Istarsh as its figurehead,
overthrew him...
And that is how the present York was established,
if my memory serves..."
Fain: "I know that story too! And
the three outstanding knights behind that battle
are the origin of the present title 'Three Sword Knights,'
aren't they?"
Tyron: "Precisely. And Ciel is the daughter
the sole survivor of the Falmight royal family,
its third princess, Lady Phyllis Alma Falmight,
and Aclesia's son..."
Ymir: "Then her relationship to Her Majesty Queen Alforina is..."
Garyud: "They are cousins."
Ciel: "F-Father...
I don't understand what is happening..."
Garyud: "It is only natural that you are confused.
My grandfather was a veteran knight of the Falmight royal family.
He escaped while protecting Lady Phyllis,
but suffered grave wounds. My father inherited his will,
and then I inherited it.
My father and I both kept that duty.
Following Lady Phyllis's last wishes, I kept this from you until today.
I apologize for that.
But it is the absolute truth.
And you are my sovereign."
Ciel: "Father... Please don't speak to me
in that way...
Touya: "Hey, that Falmight dynasty...
Don't tell me you're planning to restore it?"
Garyud: "No. Restoring the Falmight royal family
would be meaningless. Forcing its revival would only turn
public opinion against us.
We must cast off the old mantle of Falmight.
Lady Phyllis did not wish for such a thing either.
That is precisely why, even after she came under the protection of the Istarsh royal family,
you were raised as my daughter rather than as royalty."
Ciel: "Th-Then why tell me now...?"
Garyud: "York has already begun to walk a new path.
And now it must move to the next stage.
That was Her Majesty's... Queen Alforina's
dying wish, as it was Aclesia's.
We must not let York's flame go out.
What matters is our 'aspirations,' not our 'blood.'"
Ciel: "But even so, for me to be queen..."
Garyud: "...I am saying this because I recognize Ciel, the individual,
as someone worthy to guide York as its queen.
That is why.
I am certainly not saying it because you are
of royal blood.
These eyes of mine have not yet lost their discernment.
Or do you not trust me?"
Ciel: "N-No, nothing of the sort... But..."
Garyud: "It is true that to lead the people, proof of 'blood'
is needed... And you have that.
A person's worth is not determined by their lineage, but
this is for the sake of guiding York.
Surely Lady Phyllis would forgive us."
Xiujian: "So, rather than restoring the Falmight dynasty,
you intend to establish Ciel as queen
and rebuild a new York..."
Garyud: "Yes."
Ciel: "..."
Garyud: "...Ciel. I am sorry I kept this from you.
But I did not raise you
because you were of royal blood.
To me, you are my sovereign,
and you are also my daughter."
Ciel: "Father..."
Garyud: "Under Her Majesty Alforina, York was about
to enter a new era.
That flame must never be extinguished.
And Ciel, you are York's new sovereign."
Ciel: "B-But... I... In my veins,
there is also Falmight blood..."
Garyud: "You can atone for the deeds and sins of the past
through your achievements in the future. Besides, I do not recall
raising a daughter incapable of doing even that."
Tyron: "Have confidence in yourself."
Reduce: "I would gladly dedicate my sword to Ciel."
Ciel: "Everyone..."
Garyud: "You are not alone.
There is no need to bear it all by yourself.
That is why we are here."
Ciel: "Father..."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ciel: "...Very well.
Though I have little talent, this great responsibility as queen...
I will accept it."
Yamato: "This is quite a sudden turn of events, meow."
Touya: "But I don't think it's a bad one.
I've got no reason to back that up, though."
Garyud: "...Then, as your first duty as our new sovereign,
pass judgment on one who turned his sword on his compatriots, even for his homeland's sake."
Ciel: "What?!"
Touya: "H-Hey! You mean..."
Tyron: "..."
Reduce: "Lord Garyud?!"
Tyron: "No, whatever my reasons may have been,
it is a fact that I attacked and betrayed our allies.
To uphold discipline, it is necessary to pass judgment on me."
Ciel: "..."
Garyud: "Now, Your Majesty. Your judgment!"
Reduce: "..."
Ciel: "..."
Yamato: "She drew her sword, meow..."
Touya: "...Whoa, whoa. Is she serious?"
Tyron: "..."
Kasumi: "Eek!"
Yamato: "...Huh? She stopped?"
Clovis: "A hair's breadth above his head."
Xiujian: "Excellent skill."
Fain: "Just what I'd expect from one of the Three Sword Knights!"
Tyron: "...Ciel...?"
Ciel: "...Death doesn't solve everything.
Tyron, was your loyalty to Her Majesty a lie?"
Tyron: "N-No. I swear before the gods it was not."
Ciel: "Then live and work for this country.
For the people, rather than for me."
Tyron: "...Yes, Your Majesty. My life is yours, Queen Ciel.
No, it belongs to York."
Reduce: "Ciel..."
Ciel: "...Will that do?"
Garyud: "Heh..."
Maki: "Judgment was passed, and a new queen was born.
Here, York took a new step forward... Something like that."
Grad: "Thank you for all you have done for us.
This kindness..."
Ymir: "We only did what was right.
Please take your time recovering."
Grad: "Yes."
Thora: "We pray for your success in battle."
Ymir: "Thank you.
There may still be many things to worry about,
but do your best."
Thora: "Y-Yes."
Yamato: "Huh? I don't see that girl anywhere, meow."
Ymir: "Um, where is your daughter?"
Thora: "She hasn't shown herself for a while."
Grad: "Knowing her,
perhaps she's fascinated by Mr. Garyud's Bosendorfer
this time?"
Touya: "Oh, that's possible."
Grad: "Ahahaha. Just who does she take after?"
Thora: "Rather than who she takes after, shouldn't the question be
whose fault it is that she turned out that way?"
Grad: "Well, that's... Kururu was... She was interested, you see..."
Thora: "Hehehe. I'm joking.
Now then, we will take our leave."
Ymir: "Yes."
Grad: "Goodbye."
Touya: "...Hey, Kururu hasn't
snuck aboard the Liebhofen and hidden herself,
has she...?"
Yamato: "S-Surely even she wouldn't go
that far, meow..."
Sisk: "Liebhofen checks complete.
Everything is in order."
Miyasco: "...All systems normal."
Derock: "We're ready to launch at any time."
Ai: "So we're saying goodbye to this place."
Touya: "A lot happened, but I'm glad we managed to liberate it safely."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan. About Bernst..."
Ai: "Oh, right! I thought there was something suspicious about him,
but I never imagined he was ≪Ze=Ode≫.
We were completely fooled."
Kasumi: "But he protected you, didn't he, Touya-chan?
And me too..."
Touya: "Yeah... I don't know what he's thinking.
But he's our enemy. He saved you, Kasumi,
and helped us because he had a purpose."
Kasumi: "I-I suppose so... But is he really that bad a person?"
Arthur: "He seemed to place importance on the Rayblade and you, Touya.
On your very existence.
Whether that reflects ≪Ze=Ode≫'s intentions
or his own personal views, I do not know."
Aurelie: "What we do know is that he's ≪Ze=Ode≫,
that he seriously helped repair the Rayblade
and develop the anti-field system,
that he's certainly no ally,
and that he's undoubtedly a formidable enemy."
Clovis: "...Right."
Arthur: "In any case, the terrorism in the capital takes priority now.
Have you contacted anyone about it yet?"
Ymir: "Yes. I contacted Lady Ivel earlier.
We can't exactly send a transmission directly to His Highness.
Also, Emy's restoration work on the Daifozon
seems to be underway.
She said it was nearly finished, though."
Fain: "That Second? I find that hard to believe."
Ymir: "Fain, you shouldn't say things like that
in front of her."
Fain: "I know.
But to me, she is 'the Second,'
and nothing else!"
Ymir: "...Sigh."
Ai: "What's that 'Dai-whatever'?"
Ymir: "Huh? Oh... The 'Divine Sword Daifozon.'
It's the Rayblade's original weapon."
Touya: "Huh... So it had something like that..."
Clovis: "Come to think of it, where's Celica?
I haven't seen her for a while."
Ymir: "Probably in the hangar.
She said she was going to make the Rayblade's final adjustments."
Ai: "Come to think of it, it seems the Rayblade wasn't
as badly damaged as we thought. That's a relief, isn't it?"
Aurelie: "Yes.
We should be able to use it again right away."
Arthur: "Shall we go and see for now?
I think we should learn a little more about the Rayblade
as well."
Ai: "Yes. Celica's been acting strange
ever since the battle ended too."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "..."
Arthur: "...Shall we go, then?"
Yamato: "...So why has this turned into a Rayblade
activation-test tournament, meow?"
Touya: "...Don't ask me. Clovis started
saying things like 'I'm the one who deserves to pilot the Rayblade,'
Aurelie: "He may not look it, but he hates to lose."
Clovis: "...It won't move after all.
Seems two men won't work."
Ymir: "It seems it can only be operated with Touya
paired with a female pilot. What do you think, Celica?"
Celica: "..."
Ymir: "Celica?"
Celica: "Huh?! Oh, yes..."
Ai: "What's wrong with you?
You've been acting strange since we got back."
Celica: "N-No... I... haven't..."
Ai: "...Why are you looking at Touya?
Hey, what did you do to Celica?"
Touya: "What?! Wh-What do you mean... N-Nothing...
She just... I used too much Prana, and she..."
Ai: "Prana? Sure, that Prana earlier
was incredible, but..."
Ymir: "Celica, you..."
Celica: "W-Well then, I have something to do!"
Clovis: "Hmm? Wait. Only you and women can ride the Rayblade...
You've rigged something, haven't you?"
Touya: "H-Huh? How should I know?
What could I possibly do, anyway?"
Kasumi: "It's strange..."
Arthur: "At any rate, we have confirmed that it works,
so from now on, Touya and one of the others--Ai, Kasumi, Aurelie or Celica--
will sortie as a pair."
Fain: "That means one fewer Spirit Mech,
but considering the Rayblade's performance,
our fighting strength should not be a problem."
Ai: "That was a sensible opinion, coming from you."
Fain: "...What is that supposed to mean?!"
Ai: "Nothing."
Fain: "Hey! What's with that attitude?!"
Aurelie: "All right, you two. That's enough.
...Ai, what's wrong? I don't think much of that behavior."
Ai: "What? I only said what I thought."
Aurelie: "You can be irritated all you want,
but don't take it out on someone else. People won't like you for it."
Ai: "Wh-When was I irritated?!
Don't act like you know everything about me!"
Aurelie: "Good grief. You should be more honest with yourself...
Right, Touya?"
Touya: "Why are you bringing me into this?"
Clovis: "Hahahaha! Well, there's no point telling Touya."
Touya: "Shut up."
